title: Narrow Reading Column
description: An article layout that limits ShellMain to a 40rem reading column with $maxWidth, lets a figure and a pull quote break out through ShellMainFeature and ShellMainPopout, adds an aria-pressed reading mode toggle, and shows an On this page ShellSidebar only at 5xl shell widths. Use it for blog posts and long-form articles rather than app layouts with navigation sidebars.
